clue.text: Tick can be believed

definitions.note: the definition is a verb phrase standing for an adjective meaning worthy of belief

parts.note: tick is slang for credit, as in buying on tick
can means is able

explanation.surface: A tick mark on a page proves a claim is trustworthy.
explanation.walkthrough: Old usage gives this word the sense 'believable', so 'be believed' points to it loosely; British 'on tick' means on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: In its older sense the word means worthy of credence, something that may be trusted as true.

clue.text: Space to tie a boat up

indicators.note: in a down entry, up tells us to read the word from the bottom, so it runs backwards

parts.note: to moor is to tie up a boat

explanation.surface: Looking for a spot where a boat may be tied up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' looks like part of the phrase 'tie up'; in a down clue it turns MOOR backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Room is free space, as in elbow room.

clue.text: Lay-priest accommodated by theologian practised sponging

indicators.note: something accommodated by another is held inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, stands for a theologian
an abbe is a French cleric's title, often worn by men not fully ordained

explanation.surface: A cleric lodging with a scholar of religion did some cleaning.
explanation.definitionFit: To dab is to sponge lightly, so having dabbed is having done that sponging.

clue.text: One most likely to pop up when drinking another's health

definitions.text: One most likely to pop up when drinking another's health

parts.words: One most likely to pop up when drinking another's health
parts.note: a kitchen gadget whose bread pops up, and also a person who rises to raise a glass to someone

explanation.surface: Someone who leaps to their feet whenever a health is drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen appliance ejects bread, and a person proposing health drinks also bears that name.

clue.text: Naval vessel for army officer

definitions.meaning: a two-masted square-rigged sailing ship
short for brigadier, a senior army rank

explanation.definitionFit: It names a two-masted warship and is the familiar shortening of brigadier.

clue.text: Rough shingle from a part of Britain

indicators.note: rough suggests the letters are roughly handled and jumbled

explanation.surface: Coarse beach pebbles collected in some British region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rough' seems to describe the shingle; it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: England is a part of Britain, and the adjective describes things coming from there.

clue.text: Angler in favour of agricultural mechanisation

parts.note: pro means for or in favour of
a tractor is the machine that mechanised farming

explanation.surface: A fisherman who supports machines on the farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Angler' looks like a fisherman; it means something that measures angles.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawing instrument for measuring angles, so jokingly a thing that angles.

clue.text: SET back? For income earners they certainly are

definitions.text: SET back? For income earners they certainly are

parts.words: SET back? For income earners they certainly are
parts.note: forms filed with the revenue each year, which set earners back financially

explanation.surface: Earners find annual paperwork to the revenue a real setback.
explanation.definitionFit: Annual statements of income sent to the revenue, a costly chore for those who earn.

clue.text: Publicity man takes a boat from Malaysia

parts.note: PRO is a public relations officer, a publicity man

explanation.surface: A press officer acquires a Malaysian vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A proa is a fast sailing canoe with an outrigger, used in Malaysian waters.

clue.text: Patient-that is the purpose of a stretcher

definitions.meaning: patient here is an adjective meaning tolerant
a stretcher exists for carrying, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Tolerant and long-suffering in one sense; split, the letters say a stretcher is there to carry.

clue.text: Landlord is a real character

definitions.meaning: a landlord is one who lets property
a character in the sense of a written symbol of the alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: One who lets property out, and a symbol of the alphabet.

clue.text: The musician who just can't keep still

definitions.meaning: a violin player
someone who fidgets restlessly with their hands

explanation.definitionFit: A violinist, and also a restless person who fidgets.

clue.text: Difficult to believe, like exotic imports

definitions.meaning: implausible
goods brought from distant lands, literally collected from a long way off

explanation.definitionFit: Implausible, and literally describing goods brought from distant lands.

clue.text: Frustrate by removing high C from a disc concert

indicators.note: removing tells us to take a letter out of the phrase that follows

parts.note: the note C, here just the letter C

explanation.surface: Spoiling a recital by cutting a soprano's top note.
explanation.definitionFit: To unsettle or upset someone's plans or composure.

clue.text: Make-up rouge for an ugly ous tomer

indicators.note: make-up read as a verb, to make the letters up into something new

explanation.surface: Cosmetics used as a disguise by an unpleasant character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make-up' seems to describe the rouge as cosmetics; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue is a rascal or villain, an unpleasant sort.

clue.text: Snake! Stop! It's on the footpath

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
halt means stop

explanation.surface: A walker shouts a warning about a snake on the path.
explanation.definitionFit: The black bituminous surfacing laid on paths and roads.

clue.text: Silver permit for small metal ornament

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
let means permit

explanation.surface: A licence to work silver into a little trinket.
explanation.definitionFit: An aglet is a metal tag or spangle, as on a lace end.

clue.text: Not even on course

definitions.meaning: uneven, bumpy
the long grass beside a golf fairway

explanation.definitionFit: Uneven or bumpy, and the long grass bordering a golf fairway.

clue.text: Dash along the river bank

definitions.meaning: to hurry
a marsh plant that grows along water's edge

explanation.definitionFit: To hurry, and a marsh plant found growing along waterways.

clue.text: Common prison commotion

definitions.meaning: slang for jail
a fuss or disturbance

explanation.walkthrough: 'Common' marks the slang sense: in Britain prison is informally called this.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for jail, and a fuss or disturbance.

clue.text: Which ring-road route is re constructed?

indicators.note: a thing reconstructed is rebuilt in a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question about which bypass is being rebuilt.
explanation.definitionFit: Asked which ring-road, the reply 'the outer one' names it by its position.

clue.text: Time to play cricket? More than time maybe

definitions.meaning: split in two, a set of six balls is expected
late, past the time due

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls, so 'over due' means another set is to be bowled.
explanation.definitionFit: Split, it says a cricket over is expected; whole, it means late, past its time.

clue.text: News about Southampton and Dover possibly

parts.note: re means about or concerning
examples of English harbour towns

explanation.surface: Bulletins concerning two English harbour towns.
explanation.definitionFit: Accounts of events given in the press are a form of news.

clue.text: Point to reason for crime being likely to arouse feelings

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
a motive is a reason for committing a crime

explanation.surface: Showing why a crime happened stirs strong passions.
explanation.definitionFit: Something stirring strong emotions is described this way.

clue.text: Holdings equivalent to 1.25 marksin Orkney

definitions.meaning: terms of holding land or office
in old Orkney land valuation, a mark held eight ures

explanation.definitionFit: Terms of holding property, and split, a tally of Orkney land units.

clue.text: Pressing Abram to reveal his citizenship before migration

parts.note: Abram, later Abraham, came from the city of Ur before migrating to Canaan
Abram, a man, is taken as a gent

explanation.surface: Abram hurries to prove where he lived before leaving.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible Abram set out from Ur of the Chaldees, so his home city gives UR.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing matters are ones demanding immediate attention.

clue.text: Pamper a spaniel

definitions.meaning: to cosset or indulge
a breed of gun dog

explanation.definitionFit: To coddle, and a breed of gun dog.

clue.text: At work as a steeplejack maybe

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Describing a steeplejack on the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Perched on the top of something, where a steeplejack would be.

clue.text: Wildly hoot German emperor

indicators.note: wildly says the letters are thrown about out of order

explanation.surface: An imperial ruler hooting with abandon.
explanation.definitionFit: Otho is a variant of Otto, the name of Holy Roman Emperors of the German realm.

clue.text: Washing-up aids do anything but encourage menfolk

parts.note: to deter is the opposite of encouraging
gents are men

explanation.surface: Women discouraging men from helping at the sink.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleaning agents used for dishes.

clue.text: Entire loss of northern territory it complains about

definitions.text: Entire loss of northern territory it complains about

indicators.note: loss of signals that letters are taken away from the word before

parts.note: NT abbreviates Northern Territory, a region of Australia

explanation.surface: A nation grumbling at having lost its northern lands.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing NT from ENTIRE leaves the answer; the whole clue also describes the Irish state's old claim on the north.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish state long objected to partition, which left the north outside it.

clue.text: It sets forth, and is therefore no longer in place

definitions.meaning: an explanation or setting out of ideas
split, former position

explanation.definitionFit: A setting out of ideas, and split, a former position.
